title: Detent
description: One large knob on an empty page — drag it in a circle and it clicks through detents you feel as a snap in the easing. A ring of ticks lights up in sequence as the value climbs, read out below in tabular figures.
intent: Tests a tunable, tactile single-object instrument in the Tuner/Ink vein of hand-rolled, presetless controls, on the flat Swiss light palette.
